  Scenario: AC7 Every business rule of section 8 is covered by a criterion and a test (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR9 of section 8
    When the published artefacts, the kit fake, the codec fake and every example are reviewed against them
    Then the interfaces and names carry no business term, every business value is a typed field, and the protocol and fake follow the codec and refusal rules
    Then the platform owns no schema, topic or service task queue, and each rule has a test in section 16 that fails the build on a breach
    Then no example, model or fixture carries personal data, only identifiers, codes and times

  Scenario: AC8 An unknown path or operation of the codec server answers 404 and is not a refusal case (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the codec server protocol and the codec fake
    When a request is sent to a path or an operation the protocol does not provide
    Then the answer is 404 and the protocol and the fake state it
    Then 404 is not one of the five refusal cases of AC3, and the answer carries no payload

edits.old: Then 404 is not one of the five refusal cases of AC3, and the answer carries no payload

Then 404 is not one of the five refusal cases of AC3, and the answer carries no payload

  Scenario: AC9 A template activity that is retried or times out is replayed with the retry and timeout of its input (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a template activity that fails and is retried, or that does not return within its timeout
    When the kit fake replays the workflow twice
    Then the retries and the timeout follow the retry and timeout fields of the template input and no constant
    Then both replays give the same attempts, the same timestamps and the same outcome
